This article is a stub. Siliconix is an American semiconductor company that redesigned and built
the [Accusplit](accusplit.md) stopwatch from 1975 and sold its own ET 100, ET 102 and ET 110
digital stopwatches to swimmers through [Recreonics](recreonics.md).

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
